description: Mozambique: Rural Water Supply Baseline Study 2011 is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by University Libraries, Virginia Tech. In 2007, the Millennium Challenge Corporation (MCC) signed a $506.9 million compact designed to reduce poverty in Mozambique by promoting sustainable economic growth. Among the planned investments was the installation of 600 improved water points in rural communities across the provinces of Nampula and Cabo Delgado. Coverage: Mozambique. The portal files it under the publisher University Libraries, Virginia Tech. Its tags are hand pumps, small-scale solar systems, rural water, Mozambique, water. The repository dates the deposit 2016; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
